questions.prompt: The senate assembled in great numbers to hear the testimony.
questions.answer: Senātus frequēns convēnit ut testimōnium audīret.

questions.prompt: Throughout the whole war he was constantly at my side.
questions.answer: Per tōtum bellum assiduus mēcum fuit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers, though few, defended the threshold bravely.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, quamquam paucī, līmen fortēs dēfendērunt.

questions.prompt: The girls came willingly to the ancient temple.
questions.answer: Puellae ad templum antīquum libentēs vēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The invincible general advanced first into the enemy line.
questions.answer: Dux invictus prīmus in hostium aciem prōcessit.

questions.prompt: The old men, ever wakeful, kept watch through the night.
questions.answer: Senēs pervigilēs per tōtam noctem excubuērunt.

questions.prompt: At first light the messenger arrived unexpectedly.
questions.answer: Prīmā lūce nūntius inopīnātus advēnit.

questions.prompt: The bull rushed headlong upon the terrified farmer.
questions.answer: Taurus praeceps in agricolam territum ruit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers crossed the swollen river safely.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs flūmen tumidum incolumēs trājēcērunt.

questions.prompt: The queen reigned happily and beloved by all.
questions.answer: Rēgīna fēlīx et ab omnibus amāta rēgnāvit.

questions.prompt: The wounded men fell forward onto the bloodied ground.
questions.answer: Virī vulnerātī in terram cruentam prōnī prōcubuērunt.

questions.prompt: The daughter returned home safe from the long journey.
questions.answer: Fīlia ex longō itinere sōspes domum rediit.

questions.prompt: The consul spoke last in the crowded senate.
questions.answer: Cōnsul postrēmus in senātū frequentī dīxit.

questions.prompt: The angry citizens rushed into the forum.
questions.answer: Cīvēs īrātī in forum ruērunt.

questions.prompt: Though wounded, the leader remained unconquered.
questions.answer: Dux, quamquam vulnerātus, invictus mānsit.

questions.prompt: The sailors reached the harbor glad and eager.
questions.answer: Nautae portum laetī et cupidī attigērunt.

questions.prompt: He came voluntarily to the general's camp.
questions.answer: Ad castra ducis voluntārius vēnit.

questions.prompt: The women stood silent before the sacred threshold.
questions.answer: Fēminae ante līmen sacrum tacitae stetērunt.

questions.prompt: The boy alone guarded the undying fire.
questions.answer: Puer sōlus ignem perpetuum custōdiēbat.

questions.prompt: A dense crowd filled the whole forum.
questions.answer: Multitūdō frequēns tōtum forum complēvit.

questions.prompt: The exiles returned late to their fatherland.
questions.answer: Exsulēs sērī in patriam revertērunt.

questions.prompt: The swift horsemen pursued the fleeing enemy.
questions.answer: Equitēs celerēs hostēs fugientēs secūtī sunt.

questions.prompt: The philosopher lived frugal and content in his small house.
questions.answer: Philosophus in parvā domō parcus et contentus vīxit.
